# What should this deposition invoice actually total?

> Free deposition transcript pricing calculator for freelance court reporters: turn page count, turnaround, travel, copies, and exhibits into an invoice total and an effective hourly rate, and check whether an agency's flat offer is worth the day. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
